gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-asap: Technical and a little stiff, Azeret Mono spaces its letters out like a terminal readout. Asap, a plain sans with open arcs and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, carries a long stretch of text smoothly and without fuss.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-epilogue: Typewriter-stiff yet loosely spaced, Azeret Mono holds one width for every letter. And Epilogue slips in underneath with curvy, wire-thin strokes and a tall lowercase, so the rigid top line gives way to something softer.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-gambetta: Bespoke Stencil stamps out plain, commanding letters with an industrial bluntness. Gambetta, a classic serif, shifts its stroke weight gently and opens wide channels into each counter, so extended reading stays graceful.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-lora: Commanding and industrial, Bespoke Stencil is built to hit hard with flat, low-variation strokes. Lora, a text serif, does the opposite job, letting its curves thin modestly and its broad c welcome the eye line after line.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-bespoke-slab: Tight, flat and stencil-cut, Bevellier packs a wide-looking lowercase into very close sidebearings. Bespoke Slab, a classic serif with tall lowercase bodies, then feels grounded and refined over a longer page.
gen-fs-britney-fs-recia: Britney's calligraphic hand runs narrow and tight, every curve as thin as a drawn thread. Recia brings a sharper, more authoritative serif underneath, with light modulation and generous openings that give the loose script something firm to lean on.
gen-fs-chubbo-fs-sentient: Chubbo draws smooth, unobstructed bends as if with a marker tip, casual and inviting. Yet Sentient, a classic serif with pinched, closed-in apertures, tightens things back up with a more sophisticated, contemporary voice.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-bree-serif: Chubbo's g is drawn in one unchanging line weight, with smooth marker-like bends all around. Bree Serif follows with outsized lowercase proportions, and that bigger body against the heading's moderate height is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-quando: Marker-tip bends, one thick thread! Chubbo keeps its lowercase at a moderate height, while Quando, a serif with sparse spacing, stands taller. The difference feels bookish.
gen-fs-excon-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime fills most of its height with lowercase and draws with the line of a technical pen. But Excon, crowded like chalk marks on a slate, gives the heading a towering, efficient presence, so a longer passage reads precise and structured.
